high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "thedekorcompany." The post features a vintage-style wall clock with a pastel green frame and a white face. The clock has Roman numerals marking the hours and is adorned with a decorative emblem at the center that reads "Château Renier" and "Châteauneuf du Pape," indicating it is a Grand Cru Classé wine appellation. The clock also includes the text "Appellation Renier Contrôlée." The post is labeled as sponsored and includes a call-to-action button labeled "Shop Now," suggesting that viewers can purchase the item
